lessons.rule: Never include apostrophes or unescaped colons in ASS/drawtext file paths passed to FFmpeg filtergraphs; always use neutral filenames like subs_clip_01.ass inside /tmp/clip_work/.
Never upload isolated unedited GTA 6 cutscenes, ending spoilers, or pre-launch leaked footage; require transformative hook banner, word-by-word captions, or reaction framing.
Keep punch-in gap >= 18.0s and max zoom <= 1.06x on vertical crops; more frequent zooms (>3/min) read as visual twitching and hurt retention.
